# SDK Release Process

To ensure the SDK is well tested and minimize the chance of app unable to run due to SDK upgrade, we refined the procedure to release new SeaTalk RN SDKs and providing the clients for RN App developers to test.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

In the case of the SDK has breaking changes (which we try to avoid as much as possible), the procedure is different.
